packageRules.description: engines.node is the range of Node.js versions contributors may use, not a dependency: never pin or bump it (CI chooses its own Node.js version in ci.yml).
TypeScript stays below 6.1 until typescript-eslint supports newer versions (its peer range stops at <6.1.0 as of 2026-10-14). Remove this rule once it does.

react-query-devtools stays below 5.108.2, which needs solid-js 1.9.20: pnpm refuses it (trustPolicy in pnpm-workspace.yaml), since it was published without provenance after solid-js 2.0 had some. That policy exempts releases older than 30 days: remove this rule after 2026-12-19, or sooner if a solid-js 1.9 release with provenance replaces it.
